podcast.body: A song from the *Anima* album, "46 and 2" is recognized for its "confounding" and intricate time signatures, with drummer Danny Carey notable for incorporating 4/4, 7/8, and 3/8 rhythms, sometimes simultaneously. According to frontman Maynard James Keenan, the song alludes to the theoretical evolution of humans from having 46 chromosomes to 48, a concept rooted in the theories of Carl Jung. "A typically confounding tool song called 46 and 2, which according to Maynard, alludes to how humans will eventually evolve from having 46 chromosomes to 48."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: From the *Lateralus* album, this song contains a specific bass part at the end which, due to the way distortion was hitting it, falls in the "wrong place in a couple spots." This detail consistently bothers producer David Botrell when he revisits the track. "there are moments in one of the two songs, 46 and two at the end of that song where the bass, like it's got this offbeat bass, but because of the way the distortion was hitting it, it kind of hit in the wrong place in a couple spots and it always drives me crazy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song by Tool has been notably covered by Militia Fox. "She's got a great cover of Tools 46 and 2..."
